desc:
TAKE IT ON THE GO: This Honey Nut Cheerios individual cereal cup is great to grab and go; Enjoy it as part of breakfast; Pack one for an after school snack, a treat in the car, or anytime you need a tasty snack on the move

MADE WITH REAL HONEY: Sweetened whole grain oat cereal with real honey and natural almond flavor in every delicious spoonful; Whole grain oats are the first ingredient in this honey nut cereal for kids and adults

WHOLE GRAIN: 31g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily) and an excellent source of vitamin D; Contains no artificial flavors and no artificial colors

BREAKFAST FOOD OR SNACK: Delicious with or without milk; It's a cereal the whole family loves and makes an ideal pantry staple

CONTAINS: Twelve single serve plastic cups of crunchy Honey Nut Cheerios Single Serve Cereal Cup, 1.8 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Key Features:

Made with Whole-Grain Oats: The primary ingredient is whole-grain oats, offering a wholesome and hearty base.

Lightly Sweetened with Honey: Real honey and natural almond flavor provide a signature sweet taste that appeals to kids and adults.

Certified Gluten-Free: Safe for those with gluten sensitivities, made without wheat ingredients.

Fortified with Essential Nutrients: Includes 12 key vitamins and minerals like calcium, iron, and vitamin D.

Heart-Healthy: Contains soluble fiber from oats, which can help reduce cholesterol levels as part of a healthy diet.

Benefits:

Supports Heart Health: Soluble fiber from oats may help lower LDL (bad) cholesterol.

Provides Balanced Nutrition: Offers essential nutrients and whole grains in a quick, easy breakfast option.

Family-Friendly Flavor: Sweet and satisfying without being overly sugary—loved by all ages.

Convenient and Versatile: Can be eaten with milk, yogurt, or enjoyed as a dry snack.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Starch, Honey, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Natural Almond Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
